student_learning_goal: I can record steps with pictures.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can record steps with pictures.
header.character_watermark: Bot the Robot Programmer in the top-right with arrow strips. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Three codes show paths. Circle the one that reaches the apple.
parts.visual_layout: Three code strips beside a 4x4 grid showing Bot and an apple.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten code-pick layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. 3 code strips: A=→→, B=→↑, C=→→↑↑. Beside: 4x4 grid with Bot at A1 and apple at C3.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_PICK at Part 1: keywords name the codes strips selection task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a 4-step code on the strip to reach the heart.
parts.visual_layout: Empty 4-box code strip beside a small grid with Bot and heart.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten code-drawing workspace for coding worksheet, B&W line art. Empty 4-box code strip. Beside: 4x4 grid with Bot at A1 and heart at B2.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_DRAW at Part 2: keywords name the strip code drawing task.

parts.student_instructions: Number 4 scrambled arrows in order so Bot reaches the star.
parts.visual_layout: Four scrambled arrow icons with empty number boxes for ordering.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten arrow-ordering layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. 4 scrambled arrows: ↑, →, →, ↑. Each with empty number box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_ORDER at Part 3: keywords name the arrows ordering numbering task.

parts.answer_key: →→↑↑ or any order that reaches star.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a 6-step code.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check arrow drawing. Part 3 transfer: swap target so scrambled arrows include extras the child must NOT use — verifies sequencing beyond rehearsed examples.
